<title>Metal Pailwans – Die-Cast Cars</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@500;700;900&family=Montserrat:wght@300;400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#050505;--panel:#0e0e11;--gold:#d4af37;--gold2:#f6e08f;--silver:#c9ccd1;--text:#f4f1ea;--muted:#9a968b;--line:rgba(212,175,55,.25);color-scheme:dark;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{--bg:#050505}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#050505}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:70px}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:'Montserrat',system-ui,Arial,sans-serif;line-height:1.7;overflow-x:hidden}
.serif{font-family:'Cinzel',Georgia,serif}
.gold{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#8a6d1c,#f6e08f 40%,#d4af37 60%,#8a6d1c);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:30;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:14px 6%;padding-top:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));background:rgba(5,5,5,.96);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.brand{font-family:'Cinzel',Georgia,serif;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:3px;font-size:1.05rem}
nav div a{color:var(--silver);text-decoration:none;margin-left:22px;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;transition:.3s}
nav div a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.hero{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:100px 6% 60px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%,rgba(212,175,55,.2),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 100%,rgba(212,175,55,.08),transparent 50%)}
.hero img{width:min(520px,82%);height:auto;mix-blend-mode:lighten}
@keyframes float{50%{transform:translateY(-12px)}}
.hero p{max-width:560px;color:var(--muted);margin:10px auto 30px;font-weight:300}
.btns{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
.btn{padding:14px 34px;border:1px solid var(--gold);color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;letter-spacing:3px;font-size:.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;transition:.4s;cursor:pointer;background:none}
.btn.fill{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#b8922a,#f6e08f,#b8922a);color:#111;font-weight:600;border-color:transparent}
.btn:hover{box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(212,175,55,.45);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.marq{overflow:hidden;border-block:1px solid var(--line);padding:18px 0;background:#0a0a0c}
.marq div{will-change:transform;display:flex;gap:60px;width:max-content;animation:scroll 30s linear infinite}
.marq span{font-family:'Cinzel',Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:6px;color:var(--silver);opacity:.7;white-space:nowrap}
.marq span:after{content:"\2726";color:var(--gold);margin-left:60px}
@keyframes scroll{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
section{padding:90px 6%}
.eyebrow{color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:6px;font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;text-align:center}
h2.t{font-family:'Cinzel',Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4.5vw,3rem);text-align:center;margin:8px 0 12px}
.line{width:90px;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);margin:0 auto 34px}
.filters{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:40px}
.filters button{background:none;color:var(--silver);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);padding:9px 22px;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;transition:.3s;font-family:inherit}
.filters button:hover,.filters button.on{border-color:var(--gold);color:#111;background:var(--gold)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(290px,1fr));gap:28px;max-width:1300px;margin:auto}
.card{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#141417,#09090b);border:1px solid var(--line);position:relative;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .4s,box-shadow .4s,border-color .4s;overflow:hidden}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-10px);border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(212,175,55,.18)}
.pic{aspect-ratio:16/10;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 60%,#2a2411,#0a0a0c);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.pic img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s}
.card:hover .pic img{transform:scale(1.08)}
.pic svg{width:80%;height:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.6))}
.pic:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0 0;height:45%;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(5,5,5,.75));pointer-events:none}
.pic{position:relative}
.card:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);z-index:2;opacity:.6}
.info{padding:20px 22px 24px}
.info small{color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.66rem}
.info h3{font-family:'Cinzel',Georgia,serif;font-size:1.2rem;margin:4px 0 8px;font-weight:700}
.info .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;color:var(--muted);font-size:.8rem}
.fav{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;z-index:2;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--gold);width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;font-size:1.1rem}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:20px;max-width:1000px;margin:auto;text-align:center}
.stats div{padding:30px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#0b0b0d}
.stats b{display:block;font-family:'Cinzel',Georgia,serif;font-size:2.8rem}
.stats span{color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:3px;font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase}
.feat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:26px;max-width:1100px;margin:auto}
.feat div{padding:34px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(160deg,#121215,#080809);text-align:center}
.feat i{font-style:normal;font-size:2rem;display:block;margin-bottom:10px}
.feat h4{font-family:'Cinzel',Georgia,serif;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--gold2)}
.feat p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
footer{text-align:center;padding:50px 6%;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:#030303}
footer p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:2px;margin-top:8px}
.sub{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);max-width:560px;margin:-14px auto 36px}
.story{max-width:760px;margin:auto;text-align:center;color:var(--silver);font-weight:300;font-size:1.05rem}.story p+p{margin-top:16px}
.founder{max-width:420px;margin:50px auto 0;text-align:center;padding:36px 26px;border:1px solid var(--gold);background:linear-gradient(160deg,#16130a,#070707);box-shadow:0 0 50px rgba(212,175,55,.12)}
.avatar{width:92px;height:92px;border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:'Cinzel',Georgia,serif;font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:900;color:#111;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#8a6d1c,#f6e08f,#d4af37);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(212,175,55,.35)}
.team{display:flex;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-top:50px}.team .founder{margin:0;flex:1 1 260px;max-width:400px}
.founder h3{font-family:'Cinzel',Georgia,serif;font-size:1.6rem}
.founder small{color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:4px;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.72rem}
.soon{position:absolute;bottom:10px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;color:var(--gold);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;z-index:3}
.big{position:relative}
@media(max-width:560px){nav{padding-left:4%;padding-right:4%}nav div a{margin-left:9px;font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.5px}.brand{font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:1px}}
.cust{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:26px;max-width:1200px;margin:auto}
@media(max-width:860px){.cust{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.cprev{border:1px solid var(--line);background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 70%,#2a2411,#09090b);padding:18px;align-self:start}
.cprev svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.bl{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;color:var(--silver);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:12px}
.bar{height:6px;background:#222;margin:4px 0 6px}.bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8a6d1c,#f6e08f);transition:width .5s}
.cctl{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#0b0b0d;padding:20px}
.cctl h5{color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:3px;font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;margin:16px 0 8px;font-weight:600}
.cctl h5.f{margin-top:0}
.sw{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #333;cursor:pointer;margin:0 8px 8px 0}
.sw.on{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #000,0 0 0 4px var(--gold)}
.chip{background:none;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:var(--silver);padding:7px 14px;margin:0 6px 6px 0;cursor:pointer;font-size:.78rem;font-family:inherit}
.chip.on{background:var(--gold);color:#111;border-color:var(--gold)}
select.csel{width:100%;background:#111;color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--gold);padding:10px;font-family:inherit}
.sum{color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem;margin:14px 0;line-height:1.7}
.sum b{color:var(--gold2);font-weight:600}
@keyframes up{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes logoIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.9)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes down{from{transform:translateY(-100%)}to{transform:none}}
@keyframes cardIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px) scale(.97)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes shine{to{background-position:200% center}}
@keyframes rise{0%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:0}15%{opacity:.9}100%{transform:translateY(-105vh);opacity:0}}
@keyframes bump{0%{transform:scale(.96);opacity:.7}60%{transform:scale(1.015)}100%{transform:none;opacity:1}}
@keyframes splash{to{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}}
#splash{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#050505;z-index:100;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;pointer-events:none;animation:splash .8s .5s forwards}
#splash .brand{font-size:1.5rem;letter-spacing:6px;animation:logoIn .7s both}
#prog{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8a6d1c,#f6e08f,#d4af37);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:0 50%;z-index:60}
nav{animation:down .8s .9s both}
.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.hero img{animation:logoIn 1.4s .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both}
.hero p{animation:up 1s 1.3s both}
.hero .btns{animation:up 1s 1.6s both}
.dust{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
.dust i{position:absolute;bottom:-10px;border-radius:50%;background:#f6e08f;opacity:0;animation:rise linear infinite}
.btn{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.btn:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:-80%;width:50%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.45),transparent);transform:skewX(-20deg);transition:left .7s}
.btn:hover:after{left:130%}
.marq:hover div{animation-play-state:paused}
h2.t.gold{background-size:200% auto;animation:shine 8s linear infinite}
.card{animation:cardIn .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) backwards}
.card:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at var(--gx,50%) var(--gy,50%),rgba(246,224,143,.2),transparent 55%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;pointer-events:none;z-index:1}
.card:hover:after{opacity:1}
.card.tilt{transition:transform .1s,box-shadow .4s,border-color .4s}
.cprev svg{animation:bump .45s}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}.rv{opacity:1;transform:none}.line.rv{transform:none}#splash{display:none}}
.c3d{background-color:#7a7a7a;background-blend-mode:multiply;background-size:cover;background-position:center;position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/10;cursor:grab;touch-action:none;user-select:none}
.c3d:active{cursor:grabbing}
.c3d canvas{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.hint3{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:6px;text-align:center;color:var(--gold);font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;pointer-events:none}
.ref{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;width:36%;max-width:230px;border:1px solid var(--gold);background:#000;cursor:pointer;z-index:3;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.6);transition:box-shadow .35s,border-color .35s}.ref img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/10;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:all .35s}.ref span{display:block;text-align:center;color:var(--gold);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 4px}.c3d.full .hint3{display:none}.c3d.full .ref{perspective:1000px;overflow:hidden;cursor:grab;touch-action:none;user-select:none}.c3d.full .ref:active{cursor:grabbing}.c3d.full .ref img{will-change:transform;transform-origin:50% 55%;-webkit-user-drag:none;pointer-events:none}.c3d.full .ref{top:0;left:0;width:100%;max-width:none;height:100%;border:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#000}.c3d.full .ref img{flex:1;min-height:0;aspect-ratio:auto;object-fit:contain}.cref{margin-top:16px;border:1px solid var(--gold);background:#000;position:relative}.cref img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/10;object-fit:cover;display:block}.cref .ph{aspect-ratio:16/10;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 60%,#2a2411,#0a0a0c)}.cref figcaption{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:8px 12px;color:var(--gold);font-size:.64rem;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.cref figcaption b{color:var(--silver);font-weight:400;text-align:right}.order{max-width:1100px;margin:34px auto 0;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#0b0b0d;padding:24px}
.order h3{font-family:inherit;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:4px;font-size:.85rem;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 6px}
.order .osum{color:var(--silver);font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.6;border-left:2px solid var(--gold);padding:6px 12px;margin:10px 0 18px;background:rgba(212,175,55,.06)}
.ofields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.ofields .wide{grid-column:1/-1}
.ofields label{display:block;color:var(--gold);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px}
.ofields input,.ofields textarea{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:#050506;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);color:var(--text);padding:12px;font:inherit;font-size:.9rem;outline:none}
.ofields input:focus,.ofields textarea:focus{border-color:var(--gold)}
.ofields textarea{min-height:84px;resize:vertical}
.ofields .bad{border-color:#d44}
.oact{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-top:18px}
#omsg{color:#ff8a8a;font-size:.8rem}
.odone{margin-top:18px;border:1px solid var(--gold);padding:16px;background:rgba(212,175,55,.07);color:var(--silver);font-size:.85rem;line-height:1.7}
.odone b{color:var(--gold)}
@media(max-width:640px){.ofields{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.vbtns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;margin-top:10px;justify-content:center}
.vbtns .chip{margin:0;padding:6px 11px;font-size:.7rem}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(34px);transition:opacity .9s,transform .9s}.rv.l{transform:translateX(-50px)}.rv.r{transform:translateX(50px)}.rv.z{transform:scale(.92)}.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}.line.rv{opacity:1;transform:scaleX(0);transition:transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}.line.rv.in{transform:scaleX(1)}.feat .rv:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.15s}.feat .rv:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.3s}
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.92);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;z-index:50;overflow-y:auto}
.modal.open{display:flex}
.box{background:#0c0c0f;border:1px solid var(--gold);max-width:760px;width:100%;padding:20px;position:relative;max-height:92vh;overflow-y:auto;animation:pop .35s;box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(212,175,55,.2)}
@keyframes pop{from{transform:scale(.92);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
.box .x{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;background:var(--gold);color:#111;border:0;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;z-index:2;font-size:1rem}
.big{background:radial-gradient(circle,#2a2411,#0a0a0c);display:flex;justify-content:center}
.big img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}.big svg{width:70%;padding:20px}
.box h2{font-family:'Cinzel',Georgia,serif;margin:16px 0 4px}
.specs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:10px;margin:18px 0}
.specs div{border:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px 14px}
.specs small{display:block;color:var(--gold);font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase}
.note{color:var(--muted);font-size:.75rem}

/* ---- smoothness, extra animation ---- */
@keyframes imgIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.06);filter:blur(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}}
.pic img{animation:imgIn .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both}
h2.t.gold:not(.in){animation:none}
@keyframes heart{0%{transform:scale(1)}40%{transform:scale(1.5) rotate(-10deg)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
.fav{transition:transform .25s,background .25s,color .25s}.fav:hover{transform:scale(1.12);background:var(--gold);color:#111}.fav.pop{animation:heart .45s}
.sw{transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}.sw:hover{transform:scale(1.18)}.sw:active{transform:scale(.92)}
.chip{transition:background .25s,color .25s,border-color .25s,transform .2s}.chip:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}.chip.on:hover{color:#111}.chip:active{transform:scale(.95)}
nav div a{position:relative}nav div a:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-4px;height:1px;background:var(--gold);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .35s}
nav div a:hover:after,nav div a.act:after{transform:scaleX(1)}nav div a.act{color:var(--gold)}
#totop{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--gold);background:rgba(5,5,5,.85);color:var(--gold);cursor:pointer;z-index:40;opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px) scale(.8);pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .35s,transform .35s,background .25s,color .25s;font-size:1.1rem}
#totop.show{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}#totop:hover{background:var(--gold);color:#111}
.modal{display:flex;visibility:hidden;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s,visibility .3s}.modal.open{visibility:visible;opacity:1}
.ripple{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.4);transform:scale(0);animation:rip .6s linear forwards;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes rip{to{transform:scale(4);opacity:0}}
.odone{animation:pop .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.ofields input,.ofields textarea{transition:border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s}.ofields input:focus,.ofields textarea:focus{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(212,175,55,.18)}
@keyframes shake{20%,60%{transform:translateX(-6px)}40%,80%{transform:translateX(6px)}}.ofields .bad{animation:shake .4s}
.card .info h3{transition:color .3s}.card:hover .info h3,.card:focus-visible .info h3{color:var(--gold2)}
.card:focus-visible,.btn:focus-visible,.chip:focus-visible,.sw:focus-visible,.fav:focus-visible,#totop:focus-visible,.box .x:focus-visible,.filters button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold2);outline-offset:3px}
.hero.off .dust i,.hero.off img{animation-play-state:paused}.marq.off div{animation-play-state:paused}
#story,#why,footer{content-visibility:auto;contain-intrinsic-size:auto 640px}
.bar i{transition:width .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.hero img{will-change:translate}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="splash"><div class="brand gold">METAL PAILWANS</div></div><div id="prog"></div>
<nav><div class="brand gold">METAL PAILWANS</div><div><a href="#collection">Collection</a><a href="#royal">Royal</a><a href="#customize">Customize</a><a href="#story">Story</a></div></nav>

<header class="hero"><div class="dust" id="dust"></div>
<img fetchpriority="high" alt="Metal Pailwans" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Metal Pailwans logo">
<p>A premium showcase of the world's most legendary cars, in die-cast form.</p>
<div class="btns"><a class="btn fill" href="#collection">Explore Collection</a><a class="btn" href="#story">Our Story</a></div>
</header>

<div class="marq"><div id="marq"></div></div>

<section id="collection">
<div class="eyebrow rv">The Garage</div>
<h2 class="t gold rv">The Collection</h2><div class="line rv"></div>
<div class="filters rv" id="filters"></div>
<div class="grid" id="grid"></div>
</section>

<section id="royal" style="background:linear-gradient(#050505,#0b0905 50%,#050505)">
<div class="eyebrow rv">Crown Jewels</div>
<h2 class="t gold rv">Royal Collection</h2><div class="line rv"></div>
<p class="sub rv">The most prestigious names on four wheels: Rolls-Royce, BMW and Mercedes-Benz.</p>
<div class="grid" id="rgrid"></div>
</section>

<section id="customize">
<div class="eyebrow rv">Your Rules</div>
<h2 class="t gold rv">Build Your Dream Car</h2><div class="line rv"></div>
<p class="sub rv">Pick any car, then change its colour, engine, seats, wheels and tyres. Drag the 3D car to turn it in any direction.</p>
<div class="cust">
<div class="cprev"><div id="cprev"></div><div id="cref"></div><div id="cbars"></div></div>
<div class="cctl"><h5 class="f">Choose car</h5><select class="csel" id="carSel"></select><div id="cctl"></div></div>
</div>
<div class="order" id="order">
<h3>Place your order</h3>
<div class="osum" id="osum"></div>
<div class="ofields">
<div><label for="oname">Full name</label><input id="oname" autocomplete="name" maxlength="60" placeholder="Your name"></div>
<div><label for="ophone">Phone number</label><input id="ophone" type="tel" inputmode="tel" autocomplete="tel" maxlength="16" placeholder="10-digit mobile number"></div>
<div class="wide"><label for="oaddr">Delivery address</label><textarea id="oaddr" autocomplete="street-address" maxlength="200" placeholder="House / flat no., street, area, landmark"></textarea></div>
<div><label for="ocity">City</label><input id="ocity" autocomplete="address-level2" maxlength="40" placeholder="City"></div>
<div><label for="opin">PIN code</label><input id="opin" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="postal-code" maxlength="6" placeholder="6-digit PIN"></div>
</div>
<div class="oact"><button class="btn fill" type="button" data-act="submit">Order Now</button><span id="omsg"></span></div>
<div id="odone"></div>
</div>
</section>

<section style="background:#080809">
<div class="stats rv">
<div><b class="gold" id="n1">0</b><span>Models</span></div>
<div><b class="gold" id="n3">0</b><span>Brands</span></div>
<div><b class="gold" id="n4">0</b><span>Countries</span></div>
<div><b class="gold" id="n2">0</b><span>Favourites</span></div>
</div>
</section>

<section id="story">
<div class="eyebrow rv">Our Story</div>
<h2 class="t gold rv">Born From a Purpose</h2><div class="line rv"></div>
<div class="story rv z">
<p>Metal Pailwans was created with one purpose: to celebrate the cars we dream about, in tiny metal form. It began with a simple love for die-cast cars and a belief that even the smallest car can carry a huge dream.</p>
<p>Every model in our garage is chosen for its legend, from raging supercars and rally heroes to the royal names of Rolls-Royce, BMW and Mercedes-Benz. We built this home so every car lover can explore, learn and get inspired.</p>
</div>
<div class="feat" style="margin-top:50px">
<div class="rv l"><i>🎯</i><h4>Our Purpose</h4><p>To bring the world's greatest cars to every car lover in a small, beautiful form.</p></div>
<div class="rv"><i>🌟</i><h4>Our Vision</h4><p>To become the most loved home for die-cast cars.</p></div>
<div class="rv r"><i>🤝</i><h4>Our Promise</h4><p>Real cars, real details and real passion in everything we show.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="team rv"><div class="founder"><div class="avatar">T</div><h3 class="gold">Thanish H S</h3><small>Founder &amp; CEO</small><p style="color:var(--muted);margin-top:10px;font-size:.9rem">Metal Pailwans &bull; Small cars. Big dreams.</p></div><div class="founder"><div class="avatar">J</div><h3 class="gold">JAY</h3><small>Website Developer</small><p style="color:var(--muted);margin-top:10px;font-size:.9rem">Built the Metal Pailwans website.</p></div></div>
</section>

<section id="why">
<div class="eyebrow rv">Why Metal Pailwans</div>
<h2 class="t gold rv">Small Cars. Big Dreams.</h2><div class="line rv"></div>
<div class="feat">
<div class="rv l"><i>👑</i><h4>Royal Collection</h4><p>Only the greatest supercars, sports cars and legends make it into our garage.</p></div>
<div class="rv"><i>⚙️</i><h4>Every Detail</h4><p>Tap any car to see its engine, power, speed and the story behind it.</p></div>
<div class="rv r"><i>🏁</i><h4>Pure Passion</h4><p>Built by a true die-cast fan, for everyone who loves cars.</p></div>
</div>
</section>

<footer><div class="brand gold">METAL PAILWANS</div><p>DIE-CAST CARS &nbsp;•&nbsp; SMALL CARS. BIG DREAMS.</p><p>FOUNDED BY THANISH H S</p><p>WEBSITE DEVELOPED BY JAY</p></footer>

let io=null;
try{io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add("in");io.unobserve(e.target)}}),{threshold:.12})}catch(e){}
function watch(){document.querySelectorAll(".rv:not(.in)").forEach(el=>io?io.observe(el):el.classList.add("in"))}
const cardH=c=>`<div class="card" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="View ${esc(c.n)}" data-show="${esc(c.n)}"><button class="fav" data-fav="${esc(c.n)}" data-n="${esc(c.n)}" aria-label="Favourite ${esc(c.n)}">${favs.has(c.n)?'\u2665':'\u2661'}</button><div class="pic">${pic(c)}</div><div class="info"><small>${esc(DET[c.n].b)} \u2022 ${esc(c.t)}</small><h3>${esc(c.n)}</h3><div class="row"><span>${esc(c.y)}</span><span style="color:var(--gold)">View details \u2192</span></div></div></div>`;
function render(){
 document.getElementById("filters").innerHTML=types.map(t=>`<button class="${t===cur?'on':''}" data-filter="${esc(t)}">${esc(t)}</button>`).join("");
 const list=cars.filter(c=>cur==="All"||c.t===cur);
 document.getElementById("grid").innerHTML=list.map(cardH).join("");

 document.querySelectorAll("#grid .card").forEach((c,i)=>{c.style.animationDelay=i*60+"ms"});

 document.getElementById("n2").textContent=favs.size;
 document.getElementById("n3").textContent=brands.length;
 document.getElementById("n4").textContent=countries.size;
 watch();
}
function tog(n){favs.has(n)?favs.delete(n):favs.add(n);document.querySelectorAll('.fav').forEach(b=>{if(b.dataset.n===n){b.textContent=favs.has(n)?'\u2665':'\u2661';b.classList.remove('pop');void b.offsetWidth;b.classList.add('pop')}});document.getElementById('n2').textContent=favs.size}
function show(n){

 document.getElementById("modal").innerHTML=`<div class="box" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${esc(c.n)}"><button class="x" data-close aria-label="Close">\u2715</button><div class="big">${pic(c)}</div><h2 class="gold">${esc(c.n)}</h2><small style="color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:3px">${esc(c.t.toUpperCase())} \u2022 ${esc(c.y)}</small><p style="margin-top:10px;color:var(--silver)">${esc(d.d)}</p><div class="specs"><div><small>Brand</small><b>${esc(d.b)}</b></div><div><small>Country</small><b>${esc(d.co)}</b></div><div><small>Engine</small><b>${esc(d.e)}</b></div><div><small>Power</small><b>${esc(d.hp)}</b></div><div><small>Top speed</small><b>${esc(d.top)}</b></div><div><small>0-100 km/h</small><b>${esc(d.acc)}</b></div></div><button class="btn" style="margin:4px 0 14px" data-cust="${esc(c.n)}">\ud83c\udfa8 Customize this car</button><p class="note">Numbers are approximate and change with the exact version of the car.</p></div>`;
 document.getElementById("modal").classList.add("open");{const xb=document.querySelector("#modal .x");if(xb)xb.focus()}
}
let lastFocus=null;
function closeM(){document.getElementById("modal").classList.remove("open");if(lastFocus&&lastFocus.focus){try{lastFocus.focus()}catch(e){}}}
document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Escape")closeM()});

const imgC={};let ptok=0;
const cl01=v=>v<0?0:v>1?1:v;
function hexHSV(x){const r=parseInt(x.slice(1,3),16)/255,g=parseInt(x.slice(3,5),16)/255,b=parseInt(x.slice(5,7),16)/255,mx=Math.max(r,g,b),mn=Math.min(r,g,b),d=mx-mn;let h=0;if(d){h=mx===r?((g-b)/d)%6:mx===g?(b-r)/d+2:(r-g)/d+4;h*=60;if(h<0)h+=360}return[h,mx?d/mx:0,mx]}
function hsv2(h,s,v){h=(((h%360)+360)%360)/60;const c=v*s,x=c*(1-Math.abs(h%2-1)),m=v-c,t=[[c,x,0],[x,c,0],[0,c,x],[0,x,c],[x,0,c],[c,0,x]][Math.floor(h)%6];return[t[0]+m,t[1]+m,t[2]+m]}
function paintPhoto(el,rc,color){
 const m=PH[rc.n],base=String((CFG[rc.n]||{}).color||"").toLowerCase(),tok=++ptok;
 if(!m||!color||color.toLowerCase()===base){if(el.getAttribute("src")!==rc.i)el.src=rc.i;return}
 const go=im=>{
  if(tok!==ptok)return;
  const W=Math.min(im.naturalWidth,720),H=Math.round(im.naturalHeight*W/im.naturalWidth),cv=document.createElement("canvas");cv.width=W;cv.height=H;
  const x=cv.getContext("2d");x.drawImage(im,0,0,W,H);
  let d;try{d=x.getImageData(0,0,W,H)}catch(e){el.src=rc.i;return}
  const t=hexHSV(color),ach=t[1]<.25,hc=m.h,tol=m.t,ms=m.s,b=m.b,f=.05,hw0=tol*(ach?.8:.6),hw1=tol*(ach?.6:.4),k2=ach?.3:.6,s1=ms*(ach?.35:.4),p=d.data;
  for(let yy=0;yy<H;yy++){
   const fy=yy/H,wy=cl01((fy-b[1])/f)*cl01((b[3]-fy)/f);if(!wy)continue;
   for(let xx=0;xx<W;xx++){
    const fx=xx/W,wx=cl01((fx-b[0])/f)*cl01((b[2]-fx)/f);if(!wx)continue;
    const i=(yy*W+xx)*4,r=p[i]/255,g=p[i+1]/255,bl=p[i+2]/255,mx=Math.max(r,g,bl),mn=Math.min(r,g,bl),dd=mx-mn;
    if(mx<=.1||dd<1e-4)continue;
    const sv=dd/mx,ws=cl01((sv-ms*k2)/s1);if(!ws)continue;
    let h=mx===r?((g-bl)/dd)%6:mx===g?(bl-r)/dd+2:(r-g)/dd+4;h*=60;if(h<0)h+=360;
    const dh=Math.abs((((h-hc+180)%360)+360)%360-180),w=cl01(1-(dh-hw0)/hw1)*ws*wx*wy;if(!w)continue;
    const o=ach?hsv2(h,sv*.05,Math.min(1,mx*(t[2]/.85))):hsv2(t[0],Math.min(1,sv*(t[1]/.9)),Math.min(1,mx*(.45+.55*t[2]/.9)));
    p[i]=p[i]*(1-w)+o[0]*255*w;p[i+1]=p[i+1]*(1-w)+o[1]*255*w;p[i+2]=p[i+2]*(1-w)+o[2]*255*w;
   }
  }
  x.putImageData(d,0,0);el.src=cv.toDataURL("image/jpeg",.92);
 };
 if(imgC[rc.n])go(imgC[rc.n]);else{const im=new Image();im.onload=()=>{imgC[rc.n]=im;go(im)};im.src=rc.i}
}
function wheel(cx,o){
 const t=TY[o.tyre],R=t.R,r=Math.max(5,R-t.s+(o.size-19)*0.55),f=o.fin,dk="#101012";
 let w=`<circle cx="${cx}" cy="56" r="${R}" fill="#0b0b0b"/>`;
 if(o.tyre==="off")w+=`<circle cx="${cx}" cy="56" r="${R-0.9}" fill="none" stroke="#3a3a3a" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-dasharray="2.2 1.4"/>`;
 w+=`<circle cx="${cx}" cy="56" r="${r}" fill="${f}"/>`;
 if(o.rim==="classic"){
  w+=`<circle cx="${cx}" cy="56" r="${r*.62}" fill="none" stroke="${dk}" stroke-width=".8"/>`;
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const a=i*Math.PI/2+Math.PI/4;w+=`<circle cx="${cx+Math.cos(a)*r*.38}" cy="${56+Math.sin(a)*r*.38}" r="1" fill="${dk}"/>`}
 }else{
  w+=`<circle cx="${cx}" cy="56" r="${r*.82}" fill="${dk}"/>`;
  const n=o.rim==="mesh"?14:5,sw=o.rim==="mesh"?.8:2.2;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=i*2*Math.PI/n;w+=`<line x1="${cx}" y1="56" x2="${cx+Math.cos(a)*r*.86}" y2="${56+Math.sin(a)*r*.86}" stroke="${f}" stroke-width="${sw}"/>`}
 }
 return w+`<circle cx="${cx}" cy="56" r="${r*.2}" fill="${f}"/>`;
}
function carSVG(o){
 const suv=SUV.has(o.car);
 const body=suv?"M8 52V40q0-6 6-8l8-2 8-14q2-4 8-4h92q6 0 9 4l13 14 32 3q8 2 8 12v6z":"M8 48c0-8 6-12 14-14l24-16c6-4 12-5 20-5h44c10 0 16 4 22 11l12 10c10 2 18 5 18 14v6H8z";
 const win=suv?"M38 16h38v14H30z M80 16h46l12 14H80z":"M52 28l14-13h38l18 13z";
 const wx=suv?[46,154]:[56,150];
 const seats=(suv?[56,102]:[70,94]).map(x=>`<rect x="${x}" y="18" width="9" height="12" rx="3" fill="${o.seat}"/><circle cx="${x+4.5}" cy="18" r="3.2" fill="${o.seat}"/>`).join("");
 const flame=o.eng>=2?`<path d="M9 49l-8 2.5 8 2.5z" fill="#ff8a1f"/>`+(o.eng===3?`<path d="M9 50.5l-4.5 1 4.5 1z" fill="#6cf"/>`:""):"";
 return `<svg viewBox="0 0 200 74" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><linearGradient id="bgl" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity=".38"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity=".4"/></linearGradient></defs><ellipse cx="100" cy="71" rx="90" ry="3" fill="rgba(0,0,0,.55)"/>${flame}<path d="${body}" fill="${o.color}"/><path d="${win}" fill="#1d2630"/>${seats}<path d="${body}" fill="url(#bgl)"/><ellipse cx="${suv?189:187}" cy="43" rx="3" ry="1.7" fill="#fff6c0"/><rect x="8" y="40" width="3" height="4" fill="#e53"/>${wheel(wx[0],o)}${wheel(wx[1],o)}</svg>`;
}
const sw=(a,k,v)=>a.map(([n,h])=>`<button class="sw ${v===h?'on':''}" title="${esc(n)}" aria-label="${esc(n)}" style="background:${esc(h)}" data-set="${k}" data-v="${esc(h)}"></button>`).join("");
const chip=(a,k,v)=>a.map(([x,n])=>`<button class="chip ${String(v)===String(x)?'on':''}" data-set="${k}" data-v="${esc(x)}">${esc(n)}</button>`).join("");
const nm=(a,v)=>(a.find(x=>x[1]===v)||[v])[0];
function renderCust(){
 const e=ENG[cu.eng];
 if(T3.ok)T3.update(cu);else document.getElementById("cprev").innerHTML=carSVG(cu);
 const rc=all.find(x=>x.n===cu.car);
 document.getElementById("cref").innerHTML=T3.ok?"":`<figure class="cref">${rc&&rc.i?`<img src="${rc.i}" alt="Original photo of ${esc(rc.n)}" decoding="async">`:`<div class="ph">Photo coming soon</div>`}<figcaption><span>Original photo</span><b>${rc?esc(rc.n):""}</b></figcaption></figure>`;
 const os=document.getElementById("osum");if(os)os.innerHTML="<b>"+esc(cu.car)+"</b><br>"+buildLine();
 document.getElementById("cbars").innerHTML=`<div class="bl"><span>Power</span><span>${e.p}%</span></div><div class="bar"><i style="width:${e.p}%"></i></div><div class="bl"><span>Top speed</span><span>${e.s}%</span></div><div class="bar"><i style="width:${e.s}%"></i></div>`;
 document.getElementById("cctl").innerHTML=`<h5>Body colour</h5>${sw(COLORS,"color",cu.color)}<h5>Engine</h5>${chip(ENG.map((x,i)=>[i,x.n]),"eng",cu.eng)}<h5>Seat colour</h5>${sw(SEATS,"seat",cu.seat)}<h5>Wheel style</h5>${chip(RIMS,"rim",cu.rim)}<h5>Wheel finish</h5>${sw(FINS,"fin",cu.fin)}<h5>Wheel size</h5>${chip(SIZES,"size",cu.size)}<h5>Tyres</h5>${chip(TYRES,"tyre",cu.tyre)}<div class="sum"><b>${esc(cu.car)}</b><br>Colour: ${nm(COLORS,cu.color)} \u2022 Engine: ${e.n} \u2022 Seats: ${nm(SEATS,cu.seat)}<br>Wheels: ${nm(RIMS.map(r=>[r[1],r[0]]),cu.rim)} (${nm(FINS,cu.fin)}), ${cu.size}" \u2022 Tyres: ${nm(TYRES.map(r=>[r[1],r[0]]),cu.tyre)}</div><button class="btn fill" data-act="order">Order now</button> <button class="btn" data-act="copy">Copy my build</button> <span id="cmsg" style="color:var(--gold);font-size:.8rem"></span>`;
}

let lastOrder="";
const ORDER_WHATSAPP="";/* optional: shop WhatsApp number with country code, e.g. "919876543210" */
const escH=esc;
function buildLine(){const e=ENG[cu.eng];return`Colour: ${nm(COLORS,cu.color)} \u2022 Engine: ${e.n} \u2022 Seats: ${nm(SEATS,cu.seat)}<br>Wheels: ${nm(RIMS.map(r=>[r[1],r[0]]),cu.rim)} (${nm(FINS,cu.fin)}), ${cu.size}" \u2022 Tyres: ${nm(TYRES.map(r=>[r[1],r[0]]),cu.tyre)}`}
function goOrder(){document.getElementById("order").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"start"})}
function orderNow(){
 const g=id=>document.getElementById(id),v=id=>g(id).value.replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f<>]/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim(),m=g("omsg");
 ["oname","ophone","oaddr","ocity","opin"].forEach(id=>g(id).classList.remove("bad"));
 const ph=v("ophone").replace(/[\s\-()]/g,"").replace(/^\+?91/,"");
 const bad=[];if(v("oname").length<2)bad.push("oname");if(!/^\d{10}$/.test(ph))bad.push("ophone");if(v("oaddr").length<8)bad.push("oaddr");if(v("ocity").length<2)bad.push("ocity");if(!/^\d{6}$/.test(v("opin")))bad.push("opin");
 if(bad.length){bad.forEach(id=>g(id).classList.add("bad"));m.textContent="Please fill the highlighted fields correctly.";g(bad[0]).focus();return}
 m.textContent="";
 const e=ENG[cu.eng],id="MP-"+Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase().slice(-6),
 txt=`Metal Pailwans order ${id}\nCar: ${cu.car}\nColour: ${nm(COLORS,cu.color)}\nEngine: ${e.n}\nSeats: ${nm(SEATS,cu.seat)}\nWheels: ${nm(RIMS.map(r=>[r[1],r[0]]),cu.rim)} (${nm(FINS,cu.fin)}), ${cu.size}"\nTyres: ${nm(TYRES.map(r=>[r[1],r[0]]),cu.tyre)}\n\nName: ${v("oname")}\nPhone: ${ph}\nAddress: ${v("oaddr")}, ${v("ocity")} - ${v("opin")}`,
 wa="https://wa.me/"+String(ORDER_WHATSAPP).replace(/\D/g,"")+"?text="+encodeURIComponent(txt);
 g("odone").innerHTML=`<div class="odone"><b>Order ${id} is ready</b><br>${escH(cu.car)} \u2014 ${buildLine()}<br><br><b>Deliver to:</b> ${escH(v("oname"))}, ${escH(ph)}<br>${escH(v("oaddr"))}, ${escH(v("ocity"))} - ${escH(v("opin"))}<div class="oact"><a class="btn fill" href="${wa}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Send order on WhatsApp</a><button class="btn" type="button" data-act="copyorder">Copy order</button><span id="ocm" style="color:var(--gold);font-size:.8rem"></span></div></div>`;
 lastOrder=txt;g("odone").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"nearest"});
}
function copyOrder(){const m=document.getElementById("ocm");try{navigator.clipboard.writeText(lastOrder||"").then(()=>{m.textContent="Copied!"},()=>{m.textContent="Copy not allowed here"})}catch(x){m.textContent="Copy not allowed here"}}
const OKV={color:COLORS.map(x=>x[1]),seat:SEATS.map(x=>x[1]),fin:FINS.map(x=>x[1]),rim:RIMS.map(x=>x[0]),tyre:TYRES.map(x=>x[0]),size:SIZES.map(x=>String(x[0])),eng:ENG.map((_,i)=>String(i))};
function setC(k,v){if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(OKV,k)||!OKV[k].includes(String(v)))return;cu[k]=(k==="size"||k==="eng")?+v:v;renderCust()}
function pickCar(n){const c=all.find(x=>x.n===n);if(!c)return;cu.car=n;cu.color=c.c;Object.assign(cu,CFG[n]||{});document.getElementById("carSel").value=n;renderCust()}
function copyB(){
 const e=ENG[cu.eng],t=`My Metal Pailwans build: ${cu.car} | Colour: ${nm(COLORS,cu.color)} | Engine: ${e.n} | Seats: ${nm(SEATS,cu.seat)} | Wheels: ${nm(RIMS.map(r=>[r[1],r[0]]),cu.rim)} ${cu.size}" | Tyres: ${nm(TYRES.map(r=>[r[1],r[0]]),cu.tyre)}`;
 const m=document.getElementById("cmsg");
 try{navigator.clipboard.writeText(t).then(()=>{m.textContent="Copied!"},()=>{m.textContent="Copy not allowed here"})}catch(x){m.textContent="Copy not allowed here"}
}
document.getElementById("carSel").innerHTML=all.map(c=>`<option value="${esc(c.n)}">${esc(c.n)}</option>`).join("");
renderCust();

render();
try{
 let d="";for(let i=0;i<16;i++)d+=`<i style="left:${Math.random()*100}%;animation-duration:${7+Math.random()*7}s;animation-delay:${-Math.random()*10}s;width:${2+Math.random()*3}px;height:${2+Math.random()*3}px"></i>`;
 document.getElementById("dust").innerHTML=d;
}catch(e){}
try{
 let tk=false;
 addEventListener("scroll",()=>{if(tk)return;tk=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{const h=document.documentElement,m=h.scrollHeight-h.clientHeight,y=h.scrollTop||document.body.scrollTop;document.getElementById("prog").style.transform="scaleX("+(m>0?y/m:0)+")";tk=false})},{passive:true});
}catch(e){}
try{
 const cnt=(el,to)=>{const t0=performance.now();(function f(t){const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/1200);el.textContent=Math.round(to*(1-Math.pow(1-p,3)));if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(f)})(t0)};
 const so=new IntersectionObserver(es=>{if(es[0].isIntersecting){so.disconnect();["n1","n3","n4"].forEach(id=>{const el=document.getElementById(id);cnt(el,+el.textContent)})}},{threshold:.4});
 so.observe(document.querySelector(".stats"));
}catch(e){}
try{
 if(typeof matchMedia!=="undefined"&&matchMedia("(hover:hover)").matches){
  ["grid","rgrid"].forEach(id=>{const g=document.getElementById(id);let cur=null;
   g.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{const c=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest(".card");if(cur&&cur!==c){cur.classList.remove("tilt");cur.style.transform=""}cur=c;if(!c)return;const r=c.getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5,y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5;c.classList.add("tilt");c.style.transform="perspective(800px) rotateX("+(-y*7)+"deg) rotateY("+(x*7)+"deg) translateY(-8px)";c.style.setProperty("--gx",(x+.5)*100+"%");c.style.setProperty("--gy",(y+.5)*100+"%")});
   g.addEventListener("pointerleave",()=>{if(cur){cur.classList.remove("tilt");cur.style.transform="";cur=null}});
  });
 }
}catch(e){}


/* ---- events (no inline handlers), scrollspy and extra animation ---- */
(function(){
 const $=q=>document.querySelector(q),reduce=typeof matchMedia!=="undefined"&&matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
 function ripple(b,e){if(reduce)return;const r=b.getBoundingClientRect(),d=Math.max(r.width,r.height),s=document.createElement("span");s.className="ripple";s.style.cssText="width:"+d+"px;height:"+d+"px;left:"+(e.clientX-r.left-d/2)+"px;top:"+(e.clientY-r.top-d/2)+"px";b.appendChild(s);setTimeout(()=>s.remove(),650)}
 document.addEventListener("click",e=>{
  const el=e.target.closest?e.target:e.target.parentElement,b=el&&el.closest(".btn");
  if(b)ripple(b,e);
  const t=el&&el.closest("[data-fav],[data-show],[data-filter],[data-close],[data-cust],[data-set],[data-act]");
  if(!t)return;
  const d=t.dataset;
  if(d.fav!==undefined){e.stopPropagation();tog(d.fav)}
  else if(d.show!==undefined)show(d.show);
  else if(d.filter!==undefined){if(types.includes(d.filter)){cur=d.filter;render()}}
  else if(d.close!==undefined)closeM();
  else if(d.cust!==undefined){closeM();pickCar(d.cust);const c=$("#customize");if(c)c.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"})}
  else if(d.set!==undefined)setC(d.set,d.v);
  else if(d.act==="order")goOrder();
  else if(d.act==="copy")copyB();
  else if(d.act==="copyorder")copyOrder();
  else if(d.act==="submit")orderNow();
 });
 document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{const t=e.target;if((e.key==="Enter"||e.key===" ")&&t&&t.classList&&t.classList.contains("card")){e.preventDefault();show(t.dataset.show)}});
 $("#modal").addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target.id==="modal")closeM()});
 $("#carSel").addEventListener("change",e=>pickCar(e.target.value));
 try{const links=[...document.querySelectorAll("nav div a")],map=new Map(links.map(a=>[a.getAttribute("href").slice(1),a]));
  const so=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(en=>{if(en.isIntersecting){links.forEach(a=>a.classList.remove("act"));const a=map.get(en.target.id);if(a)a.classList.add("act")}}),{rootMargin:"-45% 0px -50% 0px"});
  map.forEach((_,id)=>{const el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)so.observe(el)})}catch(e){}
 try{const b=document.createElement("button");b.id="totop";b.type="button";b.setAttribute("aria-label","Back to top");b.textContent="\u2191";document.body.appendChild(b);
  b.addEventListener("click",()=>scrollTo({top:0,behavior:reduce?"auto":"smooth"}));
  let tk=false;const img=document.querySelector(".hero img");
  addEventListener("scroll",()=>{if(tk)return;tk=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{tk=false;const y=scrollY;b.classList.toggle("show",y>700);if(img&&!reduce&&y<innerHeight*1.1)img.style.translate="0 "+(y*.18).toFixed(1)+"px"})},{passive:true})}catch(e){}
 try{[".hero",".marq"].forEach(sel=>{const el=$(sel);if(!el)return;new IntersectionObserver(es=>el.classList.toggle("off",!es[0].isIntersecting)).observe(el)})}catch(e){}
})();
</script>

sedan:{yb:.32,cy:.4,ar:.5,ax:1.5,top:[[-2.4,.32],[-2.45,.62],[-2.38,.98],[-1.55,1.02],[1.15,1.04],[2.0,.95],[2.42,.78],[2.46,.5],[2.42,.32]],can:[[-1.35,.98],[-.75,1.38],[.55,1.38],[1.25,.98]],bw:1.8,cw:1.4,roof:[-.1,1.38,1.2,1.3],R:.4,seatY:1.11,sh:.24,seats:[[-.1,.42],[-.1,-.42],[-.8,.42],[-.8,-.42]],tw:.84,hl:[2.52,.7],tl:[-2.52,.82],mir:[1.2,1.16],ex:.42,vent:[1.65,1.07,-.1],sp:[-2.38,1.08,1.45],posts:false},
hatch:{yb:.30,cy:.36,ar:.44,ax:1.2,top:[[-1.95,.3],[-2.02,.6],[-1.92,.9],[-1.2,.95],[.9,.96],[1.6,.82],[1.98,.62],[2.0,.42],[1.96,.3]],can:[[-1.7,.9],[-1.2,1.3],[-.1,1.45],[.6,1.3],[1.15,.92]],bw:1.6,cw:1.3,roof:[-.3,1.45,.7,1.1],R:.36,seatY:1.04,sh:.3,seats:[[-.3,.36],[-.3,-.36]],tw:.75,hl:[2.06,.62],tl:[-2.08,.65],mir:[.8,1.0],ex:.38,vent:[1.3,.97,-.2],sp:[-1.95,1.0,1.3],posts:true},
boxy:{yb:.50,cy:.50,ar:.58,ax:1.45,top:[[-2.15,.5],[-2.2,.8],[-2.15,1.12],[1.4,1.15],[2.05,1.1],[2.25,.95],[2.28,.65],[2.22,.5]],can:[[-2.0,1.1],[-2.0,1.85],[.95,1.85],[1.05,1.1]],bw:1.9,cw:1.55,roof:[-.5,1.85,2.8,1.5],R:.5,seatY:1.24,sh:.5,seats:[[.35,.48],[.35,-.48],[-.9,.48],[-.9,-.48]],tw:.9,hl:[2.36,.9],tl:[-2.28,.95],mir:[1.2,1.25],ex:.55,vent:[1.8,1.205,-.05],sp:[-2.1,1.9,1.5],posts:false},
suv:{yb:.40,cy:.46,ar:.55,ax:1.35,top:[[-2.25,.4],[-2.3,.7],[-2.22,1.05],[1.5,1.08],[2.1,1.0],[2.28,.82],[2.3,.55],[2.25,.4]],can:[[-1.95,1.0],[-1.85,1.62],[.85,1.62],[1.35,1.0]],bw:1.8,cw:1.5,roof:[-.5,1.62,2.5,1.4],R:.46,seatY:1.14,sh:.45,seats:[[.3,.45],[.3,-.45],[-.85,.45],[-.85,-.45]],tw:.88,hl:[2.38,.78],tl:[-2.38,.85],mir:[1.22,1.2],ex:.5,vent:[1.8,1.125,-.13],sp:[-2.0,1.72,1.4],posts:false}
};
function init(){
 const host=document.getElementById("cprev");
 host.innerHTML=`<div class="c3d"><canvas id="cv"></canvas><div class="ref" id="refbox" title="Tap to enlarge"><img id="refimg" alt="Original photo"><span id="refcap">Real photo \u2022 tap to enlarge</span></div><div class="hint3">\u21bb Drag to turn the car in any direction</div></div><div class="vbtns"><button class="chip" data-v="q">3/4 view</button><button class="chip" data-v="f">Front</button><button class="chip" data-v="s">Side</button><button class="chip" data-v="r">Rear</button><button class="chip" data-v="t">Top</button><button class="chip" id="photoBtn">Real photo</button><button class="chip" data-z="0.85">Zoom +</button><button class="chip" data-z="1.18">Zoom \u2212</button></div>`;
 const cv=host.querySelector("#cv"),refImg=host.querySelector("#refimg"),c3d=host.querySelector(".c3d"),hint3=host.querySelector(".hint3"),refBox=host.querySelector("#refbox"),refCap=host.querySelector("#refcap"),photoBtn=host.querySelector("#photoBtn");
 const togglePhoto=()=>{const f=c3d.classList.toggle("full");photoBtn.classList.toggle("on",f);photoBtn.textContent=f?"Basic 3D preview":"Real photo";refCap.textContent=f?"Real photo \u2022 drag to turn":"Real photo \u2022 tap to enlarge";if(!f){refImg.style.transform=""}};
 const hint0=hint3.textContent;let hT=0,ty=0,tx=0,fi=0,dr=null,pCar=null,pSig="",pCol="";
 refBox.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{if(!c3d.classList.contains("full"))return;dr={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,ry:ty,rx:tx,f:fi};refImg.style.transition="none";try{refBox.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}});
 const handTo3D=()=>{togglePhoto();rig.quaternion.setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(.12,-.7,0));goal=null;idle=6;hint3.textContent="Turning in 3D \u2014 drag to spin the car 360\u00b0";clearTimeout(hT);hT=setTimeout(()=>{hint3.textContent=hint0},4500)};
 refBox.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{if(!dr)return;
  const fr=FRAMES[pCar];
  if(fr&&fr.length>3){const n=fr.length,k=(((Math.round(dr.f-(e.clientX-dr.x)/14))%n)+n)%n;if(k!==fi){fi=k;refImg.src=fr[k]}return}
  const raw=dr.ry+(e.clientX-dr.x)*.3;
  
  ty=Math.max(-38,Math.min(38,raw));tx=Math.max(-14,Math.min(14,dr.rx-(e.clientY-dr.y)*.15));refImg.style.transform="rotateY("+ty+"deg) rotateX("+tx+"deg)"});
 const endDrag=()=>{if(!dr)return;dr=null;ty=tx=0;refImg.style.transition="transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)";refImg.style.transform=""};
 refBox.addEventListener("pointerup",endDrag);refBox.addEventListener("pointercancel",endDrag);
 refBox.addEventListener("click",()=>{if(!c3d.classList.contains("full"))togglePhoto()});photoBtn.addEventListener("click",togglePhoto);togglePhoto();
 const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas:cv,antialias:true,alpha:true});
 renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,1.75));
 const scene=new THREE.Scene();
 const camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(32,1.6,.1,100);
 let camDist=8.4;
 const setCam=()=>{camera.position.set(0,camDist*.28,camDist);camera.lookAt(0,.7,0)};
 setCam();
 let envOK=false;
 try{
  const pm=new THREE.PMREMGenerator(renderer),es=new THREE.Scene();
  es.background=new THREE.Color(0x15151c);
  const pl=(w,h,x,y,z,rx,ry,i,c)=>{const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w,h),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:new THREE.Color(c[0]*i,c[1]*i,c[2]*i),side:THREE.DoubleSide}));m.position.set(x,y,z);m.rotation.set(rx,ry,0);es.add(m)};
  pl(14,14,0,9,0,Math.PI/2,0,5,[1,1,1]);
  pl(14,3,9,3,0,0,Math.PI/2,3,[1,.9,.7]);
  pl(14,3,-9,3,0,0,Math.PI/2,3,[.8,.9,1]);
  pl(14,3,0,3,9,0,0,2,[1,1,1]);
  pl(14,3,0,3,-9,0,0,3,[1,.85,.55]);
  scene.environment=pm.fromScene(es,.04).texture;pm.dispose();envOK=true;
 }catch(e){}
 scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff,0x222233,envOK?.35:.8));
 const key=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,envOK?.9:1.2);key.position.set(4,7,5);scene.add(key);
 const rimL=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffd27a,.8);rimL.position.set(-5,3,-4);scene.add(rimL);
 const std=(c,m,r,x)=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial(Object.assign({color:c,metalness:m,roughness:r},x||{}));
 const paint=std(cu.color,envOK?.75:.3,.25,{envMapIntensity:1.2});
 const glass=std(0x0b1118,.6,.08,{transparent:true,opacity:.34,depthWrite:false});
 const rubber=std(0x0c0c0d,0,.92),dark=std(0x15151a,.7,.5),carbon=std(0x0e0e10,.5,.35),rotor=std(0x555a62,.8,.4);
 const seatMat=std(cu.seat,.05,.6),finMat=std(cu.fin,.95,.22,{side:THREE.DoubleSide});
 const lamp=std(0xffffff,0,.3,{emissive:0xfff2c0,emissiveIntensity:1.4}),tail=std(0x550000,0,.4,{emissive:0xff1a1a,emissiveIntensity:1.3});
 const brake=std(0xc01818,.3,.5),chrome=std(0xdddddd,1,.12);
 const glowB=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x66ccff}),glowO=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xff8a1f});
 const plat=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(4.3,4.3,.08,72),std(0x0b0b0d,.8,.35));plat.position.y=-.04;scene.add(plat);
 const ring=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(4.3,.035,12,96),std(0xd4af37,1,.25,{emissive:0x3a2a05}));ring.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;scene.add(ring);
 const rig=new THREE.Group();scene.add(rig);
 const sc=document.createElement("canvas");sc.width=sc.height=128;
 const sx=sc.getContext("2d"),gr=sx.createRadialGradient(64,64,4,64,64,62);gr.addColorStop(0,"rgba(0,0,0,.75)");gr.addColorStop(1,"rgba(0,0,0,0)");sx.fillStyle=gr;sx.fillRect(0,0,128,128);
 const sh=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(6.4,3.4),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:new THREE.CanvasTexture(sc),transparent:true,depthWrite:false}));sh.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;sh.position.y=.012;rig.add(sh);
 const liftG=new THREE.Group(),bodyG=new THREE.Group(),extrasG=new THREE.Group(),seatsG=new THREE.Group(),wheelsG=new THREE.Group();
 liftG.add(bodyG,extrasG,seatsG);rig.add(liftG,wheelsG);
 const clear=g=>{while(g.children.length){const c=g.children.pop();c.traverse(n=>{if(n.geometry&&n.geometry.dispose)n.geometry.dispose()})}};
 function bodyShape(p){
  const s=new THREE.Shape();p.top.forEach((q,i)=>i?s.lineTo(q[0],q[1]):s.moveTo(q[0],q[1]));
  const a=Math.asin((p.yb-p.cy)/p.ar);
  s.lineTo(p.ax+p.ar*Math.cos(a),p.yb);s.absarc(p.ax,p.cy,p.ar,a,Math.PI-a,false);
  s.lineTo(-p.ax+p.ar*Math.cos(a),p.yb);s.absarc(-p.ax,p.cy,p.ar,a,Math.PI-a,false);
  s.closePath();return s;
 }
 function buildBody(p){
  clear(bodyG);
  const bg=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(bodyShape(p),{depth:p.bw,bevelEnabled:true,bevelThickness:.1,bevelSize:.08,bevelSegments:4,curveSegments:18});bg.translate(0,0,-p.bw/2);
  bodyG.add(new THREE.Mesh(bg,paint));
  const cs=new THREE.Shape();p.can.forEach((q,i)=>i?cs.lineTo(q[0],q[1]):cs.moveTo(q[0],q[1]));cs.closePath();
  const cg=new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(cs,{depth:p.cw,bevelEnabled:true,bevelThickness:.06,bevelSize:.06,bevelSegments:3});cg.translate(0,0,-p.cw/2);
  bodyG.add(new THREE.Mesh(cg,glass));
  const rf=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(p.roof[2],.05,p.roof[3]),paint);rf.position.set(p.roof[0],p.roof[1]+.075,0);bodyG.add(rf);
  [-1,1].forEach(s=>{
   const h=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.05,.09,.34),lamp);h.position.set(p.hl[0],p.hl[1],s*(p.bw/2-.22));bodyG.add(h);
   const t=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.05,.07,.4),tail);t.position.set(p.tl[0],p.tl[1],s*(p.bw/2-.25));bodyG.add(t);
   const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.14,.09,.09),paint);m.position.set(p.mir[0],p.mir[1],s*(p.cw/2+.15));bodyG.add(m);
   const ex=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.06,.06,.14,16),chrome);ex.rotation.z=Math.PI/2;ex.position.set(p.tl[0]-.04,p.ex,s*.38);bodyG.add(ex);
  });
  const g=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.05,.14,p.bw*.45),dark);g.position.set(p.hl[0]+.01,p.hl[1]-.2,0);bodyG.add(g);
 }
 function buildSeats(p){
  clear(seatsG);
  p.seats.forEach(([x,z])=>{
   const b=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.5,.08,.44),seatMat);b.position.set(x,p.seatY+.04,z);seatsG.add(b);
   const k=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.14,p.sh,.44),seatMat);k.position.set(x-.22,p.seatY+p.sh/2,z);k.rotation.z=.1;seatsG.add(k);
  });
 }
 function buildExtras(o,p){
  clear(extrasG);
  if((CFG[o.car]||{}).hood){const hp=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.0,.022,p.bw*.6),carbon);hp.position.set(p.vent[0]+.1,p.vent[1]-.004,0);hp.rotation.z=p.vent[2];extrasG.add(hp)}
  if(o.eng>=1){const v=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.55,.025,.5),carbon);v.position.set(p.vent[0],p.vent[1],0);v.rotation.z=p.vent[2];extrasG.add(v)}
  if(o.eng>=2){
   const w=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.34,.04,p.sp[2]),carbon);w.position.set(p.sp[0],p.sp[1],0);extrasG.add(w);
   if(p.posts)[-1,1].forEach(s=>{const q=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.05,.2,.05),carbon);q.position.set(p.sp[0],p.sp[1]-.1,s*.5);extrasG.add(q)});
   [-1,1].forEach(s=>{const gl=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.05,12,8),o.eng===3?glowB:glowO);gl.position.set(p.tl[0]-.13,p.ex,s*.38);extrasG.add(gl)});
  }
 }
 function makeWheel(R,rimR,o){
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  const tyre=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(R,R,.3,44),rubber);tyre.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;g.add(tyre);
  if(o.tyre==="off"){const bg=new THREE.BoxGeometry(.07,.1,.29);for(let i=0;i<30;i++){const a=i/30*Math.PI*2,b=new THREE.Mesh(bg,rubber);b.position.set(Math.cos(a)*(R+.02),Math.sin(a)*(R+.02),0);b.rotation.z=a;g.add(b)}}
  const barrel=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(rimR,rimR,.31,36),dark);barrel.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;g.add(barrel);
  [1,-1].forEach(s=>{
   const f=new THREE.Group();f.position.z=s*.162;if(s<0)f.rotation.y=Math.PI;
   const rt=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(rimR*.78,32),rotor);rt.position.z=-.004;f.add(rt);
   const cal=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.12,.2,.03),brake);cal.position.set(rimR*.38,rimR*.32,-.002);cal.rotation.z=.6;f.add(cal);
   if(o.rim==="classic"){
    f.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(rimR,40),finMat));
    for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const a=i*Math.PI/2+Math.PI/4,b=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(.02,10),dark);b.position.set(Math.cos(a)*rimR*.45,Math.sin(a)*rimR*.45,.003);f.add(b)}
    const hb=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(rimR*.26,24),chrome);hb.position.z=.005;f.add(hb);
   }else{
    f.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(rimR*.84,rimR,40),finMat));
    const n=o.rim==="mesh"?16:5,w=o.rim==="mesh"?.02:.075,sg=new THREE.PlaneGeometry(rimR*.84,w);sg.translate(rimR*.42,0,0);
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const sp=new THREE.Mesh(sg,finMat);sp.rotation.z=i/n*Math.PI*2;sp.position.z=.002;f.add(sp)}
    const hb=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(rimR*.2,24),chrome);hb.position.z=.004;f.add(hb);
   }
   g.add(f);
  });
  return g;
 }
 function buildWheels(o,p){
  clear(wheelsG);
  const R=p.R+(o.tyre==="off"?.06:o.tyre==="sport"?-.01:0),sw=o.tyre==="off"?.15:o.tyre==="sport"?.055:.08;
  const rimR=Math.min(R-.025,R-sw+(o.size-19)*.02),proto=makeWheel(R,rimR,o);
  [[1,1],[1,-1],[-1,1],[-1,-1]].forEach(([a,b])=>{const w=proto.clone();w.position.set(a*p.ax,R,b*p.tw);wheelsG.add(w)});
  liftG.position.y=R-p.R;
 }
 const cur={};let pc=new THREE.Color(cu.color),bump=0;
 function apply(o){
  const type=TYPE[o.car]||"gt",p=PROF[type];
  if(type!==cur.type){cur.type=type;buildBody(p);buildSeats(p);buildWheels(o,p);buildExtras(o,p)}
  else{
   if(o.tyre!==cur.tyre||o.rim!==cur.rim||o.size!==cur.size)buildWheels(o,p);
   if(o.eng!==cur.eng||o.car!==cur.car)buildExtras(o,p);
  }
  const rc=all.find(x=>x.n===o.car),has=!!(rc&&rc.i),sig=[o.seat,o.rim,o.fin,o.size,o.tyre,o.eng,o.hood].join("|");
  plat.visible=ring.visible=!has;c3d.style.backgroundImage=has?"url("+rc.i+")":"";
  if(!has){refBox.style.display="none";if(c3d.classList.contains("full"))togglePhoto()}
  else{
   refBox.style.display="";refImg.alt="Original photo of "+rc.n;
   const full=c3d.classList.contains("full");
   if(o.car!==pCar){if(!full)togglePhoto()}
   else if(full&&(sig!==pSig||(o.color!==pCol&&!PH[o.car]))){refCap.textContent="Saved in your build \u2022 the photo shows the real car only";clearTimeout(hT);hT=setTimeout(()=>{refCap.textContent="Real photo \u2022 drag to turn"},4000)}
   if(FRAMES[o.car]&&FRAMES[o.car].length>3){if(o.car!==pCar){fi=0;refImg.src=FRAMES[o.car][0]}}else paintPhoto(refImg,rc,o.color);
  }
  pCar=o.car;pSig=sig;pCol=o.color;
  cur.car=o.car;cur.tyre=o.tyre;cur.rim=o.rim;cur.size=o.size;cur.eng=o.eng;
  
  pc.set(o.color);seatMat.color.set(o.seat);finMat.color.set(o.fin);bump=1;
 }
 const Y=new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),X=new THREE.Vector3(1,0,0),qx=new THREE.Quaternion(),qy=new THREE.Quaternion();
 const VIEWS={q:[.12,-.7],f:[0,-Math.PI/2],s:[0,0],r:[0,Math.PI/2],t:[Math.PI/2,0]};
 rig.quaternion.setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(.12,-.7,0));
 let goal=null,idle=10;
 const pts=new Map();let pinch=0;
 const dist=()=>{const a=[...pts.values()];return Math.hypot(a[0][0]-a[1][0],a[0][1]-a[1][1])};
 const zoom=f=>{camDist=Math.max(5,Math.min(13,camDist*f));setCam()};
 cv.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{try{cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(x){}pts.set(e.pointerId,[e.clientX,e.clientY]);if(pts.size===2)pinch=dist();goal=null;idle=0});
 cv.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{
  const pr=pts.get(e.pointerId);if(!pr)return;
  pts.set(e.pointerId,[e.clientX,e.clientY]);idle=0;
  if(pts.size===1){qy.setFromAxisAngle(Y,(e.clientX-pr[0])*.01);qx.setFromAxisAngle(X,(e.clientY-pr[1])*.01);rig.quaternion.premultiply(qy).premultiply(qx)}
  else if(pts.size===2){const d=dist();if(pinch)zoom(pinch/d);pinch=d}
 });
 const up=e=>{pts.delete(e.pointerId);pinch=0;idle=0};
 cv.addEventListener("pointerup",up);cv.addEventListener("pointercancel",up);
 host.querySelectorAll(".vbtns button[data-v],.vbtns button[data-z]").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",()=>{
  if(c3d.classList.contains("full"))togglePhoto();
  if(b.dataset.z){zoom(+b.dataset.z);return}
  const v=VIEWS[b.dataset.v];goal=new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(v[0],v[1],0));idle=0;
 }));
 function size(){const w=cv.clientWidth,h=cv.clientHeight;if(!w||!h)return;renderer.setSize(w,h,false);camera.aspect=w/h;camera.updateProjectionMatrix()}
 try{new ResizeObserver(size).observe(cv)}catch(e){addEventListener("resize",size)}
 size();
 let vis=true,running=false,last=performance.now();
 function tick(){if(running)return;running=true;requestAnimationFrame(frame)}
 function frame(t){
  running=false;if(!vis||document.hidden)return;
  const dt=Math.min(.05,(t-last)/1000||0);last=t;idle+=dt;
  if(goal){rig.quaternion.slerp(goal,.12);if(Math.abs(rig.quaternion.dot(goal))>.99995)goal=null}
  else if(idle>5)rig.rotateOnWorldAxis(Y,.35*dt);
  paint.color.lerp(pc,.15);
  if(bump>.01){bump*=.9;rig.scale.setScalar(1-.04*bump)}else if(bump){bump=0;rig.scale.setScalar(1)}
  renderer.render(scene,camera);tick();
 }
 try{new IntersectionObserver(es=>{vis=es[0].isIntersecting;if(vis)tick()}).observe(cv)}catch(e){}
 document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",()=>{if(!document.hidden)tick()});
 T3.update=apply;T3.ok=true;{const cr=document.getElementById("cref");if(cr)cr.innerHTML=""}apply(cu);tick();
}
try{const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>{if(es[0].isIntersecting){io.disconnect();boot()}},{rootMargin:"400px"});io.observe(document.getElementById("customize"))}catch(e){boot()}
})();
</script>
